thread:
alex: quick ping — opened PR #2345 updating client SDK streaming/backpressure and adding `tool_call_timeout_ms` param. Can someone take a look today? https://git.redux/RI/pulls/2345 :eyes:

sam: on my list, should be able to review in a couple hours. any breaking changes?

alex: no breaking API changes, default behavior unchanged. added a small opt-in param and changed internal buffering behavior to avoid head-of-line stalls. left a short changelog in the PR.

tanya: will check tests — do we have an integration that simulates slow tool endpoints?

alex: added a test harness under `integration/tool-sim` and a unit test for the new backpressure path. patched a flaky e2e; still seeing intermittent 503s in smoke job.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #2345 — unit(3/3) running, integration(2/4) running.

sam: quick skim — looks reasonable. two small comments on variable naming and one nit about `max_queue_ms`. will leave inline.

rui: can this change affect Dedicated customers with strict latency SLOs?

alex: good call — added a note to the release docs. behavior only improves tail latency in most workloads; there is an opt-out for strict single-request isolation.

ken: FYI, we have a maintenance window tonight at 23:00 UTC; if you're planning to merge, do it before the window or coordinate with infra.

alex: aiming to merge by EOD UTC. if CI flakiness persists I'll queue it for morning.

tanya: CI integration failed on the simulated slow tool test: `TimeoutError: wait_for_tool_response exceeded 60s` — looks like the harness is slower in this run.

alex: investigating, might be a race with the test container startup. pushing a small tweak to the harness to wait for readiness.

sam: pushed a quick review approval pending that fix. :thumbsup:

alex: pushed fix and rebased.

ci-bot: CI started for PR #2345 — unit(3/3) passed, integration(4/4) running.

ci-bot: All checks passed for PR #2345.

maya: reviewed and :+1: — left one suggestion about a comment but not blocking.

tanya: approving now. :white_check_mark:

sam: approved.

alex: thanks all — merging now (will cut a minor SDK patch and include the release note). tagging release engineering for packaging.

rui: thanks — can you add a short note in the SDK migration guide about `tool_call_timeout_ms`? I'll ping customers on Dedicated if needed.

alex: will do — adding a short blurb in `docs/sdk-migration.md` and posting a follow-up in #customer-success.

ken: noted about merge before maintenance window, looks like timing works. :shipit:

alex: merged, release job queued. thanks everyone! :tada:
